# The Sapling Co.

> A unit of Shefali Nursery — a real plant nursery in Dankuni, Hooghly, West Bengal, growing and hand-delivering indoor plants, fruit saplings and flowering plants across India. Orders are placed over WhatsApp (+91 89022 62452); prices are in INR.

## Shop
- [Shop all plants](https://thesaplingco.in/shop): the full catalogue with filters, sort and search
- [Cart & WhatsApp checkout](https://thesaplingco.in/cart)
